name: apex-enterprise-platform
description: State-of-the-art enterprise-grade decentralized exchange and multi-signature governance treasury platform.

scripts.test:all: node test/run-all-tests.js && (cd backend/go-gateway && go test -v ./...) && (cd backend/rust-engine && cargo test)
scripts.build: npm run build:gateway && npm run build:engine && npm run deploy:local && npm run seed
scripts.start: node -e "const http=require('http'),fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');const mime={'html':'text/html','css':'text/css','js':'text/javascript','svg':'image/svg+xml','json':'application/json','png':'image/png'};const root=path.join(__dirname,'frontend','public');http.createServer((req,res)=>{let file=path.join(root,req.url==='/'?'index.html':req.url.split('?')[0]);let status=200;if(!fs.existsSync(file)||fs.statSync(file).isDirectory()){file=path.join(root,'404.html');status=404;}const ext=path.extname(file).slice(1);res.writeHead(status,{'Content-Type':mime[ext]||'text/plain'});fs.createReadStream(file).pipe(res);}).listen(4200,()=>console.log('APEX Enterprise Platform online at http://localhost:4200'));"

author: Apex Institutional Web3 Engineering
